AdminImports.title: Product import
AdminImports.intro: Load or update many products at once from a spreadsheet saved as CSV.
AdminImports.uploadHelp: Save your sheet as “CSV UTF-8” (Excel: File › Save as). Up to {rows} rows and 2 MB. The first row names the columns. A SKU already in the catalog updates that product; a new SKU creates a draft product. Nothing changes until you confirm the check report.
AdminImports.template: Download the empty template (column names only)

columns.short_en: short English description (needs an English name)
columns.category: required; the category's address (slug) in Persian or English, as shown on its page
columns.price: required for new products; in the store's display unit (Toman or Rial, as set in the store settings)
columns.compare_at_price: the old price shown crossed out; must be above the price, and goes with it
columns.status: draft or active (empty: new products stay draft, existing ones keep their status)

AdminImports.jobIntro: The check report for this file. The catalog changes only after you confirm.

statusHelp.uploaded: The file is waiting to be checked; this page updates by itself.
statusHelp.validating: Checking every row against the catalog…
statusHelp.validated: Look at the report, then confirm to import the valid rows, or cancel.
statusHelp.applying: Importing the rows in order; this page updates by itself.
statusHelp.failed: The file could not be used.
statusHelp.cancelled: This import was cancelled; nothing was changed.

fileErrors.not_utf8: The file is not UTF-8 text. In Excel choose File › Save as › “CSV UTF-8 (comma delimited)”.
fileErrors.empty: The file has no product rows.
fileErrors.malformed: The file is not valid CSV (a quote is left open).
fileErrors.too_many_rows: The file has too many rows. Split it into files of at most 5,000 rows.
fileErrors.unknown_column: Unknown column “{detail}”. Use the column names of the template.
fileErrors.file_missing: The uploaded file could not be found.
fileErrors.confirmer_not_allowed: The admin who confirmed this import can no longer run imports, so it was stopped.
fileErrors.unexpected: Something went wrong while reading the file.
fileErrors.too_many_columns: The file has too many columns (at most 40). Use the column names of the template.

AdminImports.problemsHelp: These rows are skipped. Fix them in your sheet and upload it again: rows already imported are simply updated.

rowErrors.duplicate_sku: the same SKU is on an earlier row
rowErrors.sku_is_variant: this SKU belongs to a product option, not a main product
rowErrors.title_en_required: English description needs an English name
rowErrors.en_title_required: English description needs an English name
rowErrors.invalid_price: price is not a valid amount
rowErrors.invalid_compare_at: old price must be above the price
rowErrors.invalid_part_number: a part number is not valid
rowErrors.invalid_status: status must be draft or active
rowErrors.price_pending: price not changed: a price request is waiting for approval
rowErrors.part_number_not_added: a part number could not be added
rowErrors.not_publishable: left as draft: it needs a price and an active main option
rowErrors.forbidden: not allowed for the admin who confirmed
rowErrors.slug: the product address is already used
rowErrors.invalid_slug: the name gives no usable address

errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than 2 MB. Split it into smaller files.
errors.not_allowed: This import can't be changed any more.
errors.too_many_open: You have 5 imports waiting. Confirm or cancel one before uploading another.

messages.uploaded: Uploaded. The check starts in a moment; open the import below to see the report.
messages.confirmed: Confirmed. The rows are being imported.

AdminImports.uploaderConfirms: Only the admin who uploaded this file can confirm it. You can cancel it.
